title: Meta Spatial SDK

snapshot.availability: Public Meta developer package/documentation plus public sample repository
snapshot.samples_repository_licence: Majority MIT; SDK/supporting materials and specified assets remain under Meta Platform Technologies SDK License

capability_evidence.hands_only_locomotion: HandMicrogestureLocomotionSystem provides opt-in teleport, snap-turn and step navigation using hand microgestures.
capability_evidence.animated_node_attachment: TransformParent can bind an entity to a named or indexed animated mesh node with explicit fallback to the parent entity.
capability_evidence.audio_control: Runtime playback and looping controls are documented in 0.14.0.
capability_evidence.artifact_size: Meta reports approximately 60 percent lower compiled shader storage.

authority_boundary: Research admission authorizes method extraction only. It does not authorize SDK installation, source/assets ingestion, Meta configuration, runtime mutation, Battle Bridge execution or physical headset acceptance.
